categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: intelligent manufacturing equipment and new energy vehicle motor and electronic control components. The intelligent equipment segment includes power battery intelligent equipment, powertrain intelligent equipment, and car body intelligent connection equipment. The new energy vehicle segment focuses on electric drive motors, motor controllers, onboard power supplies, and integrated electric drive systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as AI-driven virtual debugging, digital twin systems, machine vision, laser welding, and modular design platforms. It employs non-standard customized production for intelligent equipment and make-to-order production for standardized new energy vehicle components. The company also integrates third-generation wide bandgap semiconductor materials and high-voltage SiC technology in motor control products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global and domestic automotive manufacturers such as Tesla, Volkswagen, BMW, Volvo, NIO, Chery Jaguar Land Rover, and battery manufacturers like CATL and BYD. The company serves the automotive industry, focusing on electric vehicles and intelligent manufacturing sectors, with products used in battery production, powertrain assembly, and vehicle body manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hefei, Anhui Province, and has established subsidiaries and offices in Germany, the UK, the USA, Japan, and Hong Kong. Its international business serves global automotive clients and is expanding through overseas subsidiaries and localized supply chains.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive supply chain, providing intelligent manufacturing equipment and core electric drive components. It acts as a key equipment and component supplier to automotive OEMs and battery manufacturers, integrating upstream technologies into final assembly and testing solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI integration in intelligent manufacturing, developing high-efficiency and integrated electric drive systems, and expanding international markets. R&D focuses on multi-disciplinary innovation, digital twin technology, machine vision, SiC-based motor control, and lightweight, low-noise electric drive solutions. The company also emphasizes collaboration with universities and industry partners to accelerate technology commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized intelligent manufacturing equipment and standardized new energy vehicle motor and electronic control components. The company secures orders mainly via bidding and contracts with automotive manufacturers and battery producers. Additional income comes from government subsidies, investment income, and service fees related to product lifecycle management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier in intelligent manufacturing equipment and new energy vehicle motor control components, competing with international and joint venture firms. It holds a strong market share in China and is recognized for its technological innovation and quality, serving top-tier automotive brands globally. The company faces competition from established global players and emerging domestic enterprises advancing in technology and market reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 3.52 billion, a slight decline of 4.54% year-over-year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 21.3 million, marking a turnaround from previous losses. Total assets reached RMB 7.6 billion, growing 6.12% from the prior year. The company maintains a stable equity base and continues to invest significantly in R&D, accounting for 6.25% of revenue, supporting sustained growth and profitability improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its dual-core business model combining intelligent manufacturing equipment and electric drive components, enabling deep integration and synergy. It offers high-precision, high-reliability, and flexible production solutions supported by proprietary AI and digital twin technologies. Its products feature advanced materials and designs for efficiency, safety, and lightweight performance, catering to leading automotive OEMs with customized, innovative solutions that enhance manufacturing quality and vehicle performance.
